node.statement: Complete self-adjoint operator-space obligation. For every n>=1, lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives Co_{P_n}^2=Co_{P_n} and Co_{P_n}(X)^dagger=Co_{P_n}(X^dagger). By def-compressed-corner, S_{P_n}=Image(Co_{P_n}) is a closed linear subspace; hence it is complete in the inherited norm, and the displayed dagger identity makes it self-adjoint. Thus S_P is a complete self-adjoint operator space with its inherited matrix norms.
